branding.q: Which file format keeps a logo sharp at any size, from a favicon to a billboard?
branding.why: Vector formats like SVG store shapes, not pixels, so they scale without blurring. Keep PNG and JPG exports for everyday use.

branding.q: Which colour format is meant for printing?
branding.why: CMYK describes ink. HEX and RGB describe light on screens. Good brand guidelines list both, plus a Pantone reference if you print a lot.

branding.q: In India, how long does a trademark registration last before it needs renewing?
branding.why: A registered trademark in India is valid for 10 years and can be renewed every 10 years.

branding.q: When can a brand in India use the ® symbol?
o: Only after the trademark is registered
branding.why: ® signals a registered mark. Use ™ while the application is pending; using ® on an unregistered mark can get you into legal trouble.

branding.q: Which of these belongs in brand guidelines?
o: Logo use, colours, typefaces and tone of voice
branding.why: Guidelines tell anyone making something for the brand how it should look and sound.

branding.q: What’s a good test for a new logo?
o: Does it look good at full screen only?
Does it still work small and in one colour?
Does it use at least five colours?
branding.why: Logos live on favicons, stamps and WhatsApp profile pictures. If it fails small or in one colour, simplify it.

branding.q: How many typefaces does a small brand usually need?
o: A new one for every post
branding.why: One or two well-chosen typefaces, used consistently, make a brand recognisable. More usually looks messy.

o: How loud the brand’s ads are
How the brand sounds in words: formal, playful, direct
The music in the brand’s videos
branding.why: Tone of voice is the personality of the brand’s writing, from website copy to push notifications.

metaads.q: What size is a 4:5 image for the Facebook and Instagram feed?
metaads.why: 4:5 at 1080 × 1350 takes more screen height on a phone than a square, which is why it’s the feed favourite.

metaads.q: What size suits Stories and Reels ads?
Why keep text and logos away from the top and bottom of a 9:16 ad?
o: Profile names, captions and buttons cover those areas
metaads.why: Check every export against Meta’s current safe-zone overlay; the interface covers the edges.

metaads.q: Roughly how many optimisation events does an ad set need in a week to leave the learning phase?
metaads.why: Meta’s guidance is about 50 optimisation events in a 7-day period. Budgets too small to reach that stay in learning longer.

metaads.q: In an ad named Price_Question_Static_4x5_v1, what is “Price”?
o: The angle: the reason to buy
metaads.why: Naming every ad Angle_Hook_Format_Size_Version lets reports show which angles win, not just which ad.

metaads.q: Which signs together suggest an ad is tiring?
o: Rising frequency, falling click-through rate, rising cost per result
metaads.why: When the same people see an ad too often, they stop clicking and each result gets more expensive.

metaads.q: How many new concepts is a sensible test set for a brand spending steadily?
o: Three to five, each a different angle
As many as you can make
metaads.why: A small set of genuinely different angles answers a real question. Testing everything at once teaches nothing repeatable.

metaads.q: What happens when someone taps a Click-to-WhatsApp ad?
o: A WhatsApp chat with the business opens
metaads.why: The ad opens a WhatsApp conversation, often with a pre-filled message, which suits Indian buyers who prefer chatting before buying.
